service: your-project-name
frameworkVersion: "4"
custom:
  stage: ${opt:stage, 'dev'}
  region: ap-south-1

  serverless-offline:
    httpPort: 3000

provider:
  name: aws
  runtime: nodejs20.x
  region: ${self:custom.region}
  stage: ${self:custom.stage}
  timeout: 30
  memorySize: 512

  environment:
    NODE_ENV: ${self:custom.stage}
    AWS_REGION: ${self:custom.region}

plugins:
  - serverless-offline

functions:
  api:
    handler: src/lambda.handler
    description: Main Express API Lambda
    events:
      - httpApi:
          path: /{proxy+}
          method: ANY

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/auth/register
          method: POST

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/auth/login
          method: POST

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/auth/forgot
          method: POST

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/auth/reset-password
          method: POST

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/products/add-product
          method: POST

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/products/delete-product
          method: POST

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/products/get-products
          method: GET

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/products/get-product
          method: POST

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/products/update-product
          method: PUT

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/users/add-customer
          method: POST

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/users/get-customer
          method: GET

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/users/status-change
          method: POST

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/users/delete-customer
          method: POST

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/users/get-customerId
          method: POST

      - httpApi:
          path: /api/users/update-customer
          method: PUT
